plyty-meblowe.title: Furniture Boards
plyty-meblowe.html: Versatile composite materials from leading European manufacturers such as Pfleiderer, Swiss Krono, Kronospan and Egger. We offer laminated boards with high resistance to scratches, moisture and heat, as well as high-density HDF boards with a smooth surface ideal for further finishing. Every board guarantees dimensional stability and long-lasting functionality.

plyty-laminowane.title: Laminated Boards
plyty-laminowane.html:
Laminated boards are versatile composite materials consisting of a core board (chipboard or MDF) covered on both sides with a decorative melamine laminate. They are highly resistant to scratches, moisture and high temperatures. Thanks to the latest production technology they are more durable than lacquered boards and are ideal for kitchen and bathroom furniture.

Properties:

  • Standard thickness: 18mm (also available: 10mm, 12mm, 16mm, 22mm, 25mm, 28mm)
  • Standard format: 2800 x 2070mm or 2750 x 2100mm
  • Resistant to scratches and chipping
  • Easy to keep clean
  • Wide range of decors and textures

Applications:

  • ✅ Kitchen furniture carcasses and fronts
  • ✅ Bathroom furniture (using boards with increased moisture resistance)
  • ✅ Wardrobes, walk-in closets and bedroom furniture
  • ✅ Office furniture (desks, pedestals, shelving)
  • ✅ Children's and youth furniture
  • ✅ Built-in alcoves and wall panels

plyty-hdf.title: HDF Boards (High-Density Fibreboard)
plyty-hdf.html:
A high-density fibreboard made from wood fibres pressed under very high pressure and temperature. Thanks to its compact structure it is considerably harder and more resistant to bending than standard MDF.

Smooth surface ideal for lacquering and veneering

📐 Technical Specification

Standard thickness: 3mm, 4mm, 5mm
Density: Over 800 kg/m³
Surface: Smooth and uniform
Features: High hardness, dimensional stability, good acoustic insulation

🎯 Practical Applications

Structural Elements
  • ✅ Furniture backs (wardrobe and shelving back panels)
  • ✅ Drawer bottoms
  • ✅ Upholstered furniture components
Finishing & Decoration
  • ✅ Interior door panels
  • ✅ Underlay for floor panels
  • ✅ Decorative elements
Special applications: Small wooden goods • Precision components • Structural underlays

fronty-meblowe.title: Furniture Fronts
fronty-meblowe.html: The finishing elements of cabinets and furniture that define their appearance and functionality. We offer a full range of solutions: acrylic fronts with exceptional resistance to mechanical damage, lacquered fronts with fully customisable colours, veneered fronts combining the beauty of natural wood with stability, solid wood fronts, glass fronts with aluminium frames, curved fronts with rounded edges and milled fronts with precise patterns. Every front is tailored to the specific requirements of each room.

blaty.title: Worktops
blaty.html: Functional work surfaces that are also a key decorative element giving character to the entire interior. We offer laminate worktops with high-pressure HPL laminate imitating the texture of wood, stone or concrete, exceptionally hard sintered quartz made of 90-95% natural quartzite, artistic epoxy resin worktops with unlimited customisation options, solid wood worktops creating a warm atmosphere, luxurious granite and marble worktops and innovative Solid Surface worktops allowing seamless joints. Ideal for kitchens and bathrooms with high humidity

Resistance: Scratches, UV rays, moisture
Sheet thickness: 0.7-1mm acrylic

blaty-laminowane.title: Laminate Worktops
blaty-laminowane.html:
Made of furniture board (e.g. MDF, chipboard) covered with high-pressure laminate (HPL). Modern laminates imitate the texture and pattern of wood, stone or concrete almost perfectly, while offering excellent resistance to abrasion, stains and high temperatures.

Technical Specifications

  • Standard thicknesses: 28mm and 38mm (other variants to order)
  • Base material: MDF board or chipboard
  • Coating: High-pressure laminate (HPL)
  • Properties: Resistant to abrasion, stains and high temperatures
Edge types:
  • Straight: Standard, economical solution
  • Profiled: With a decorative rounded edge (e.g. "C" or "S" shaped)
  • Made to measure: Any shape can be milled, including curves

Applications

  • ✅ Kitchens (excellent stain resistance)
  • ✅ Offices and public buildings
  • ✅ Bathrooms (using moisture-resistant board)
  • ✅ Economical and fast projects
  • ⚠️ Avoid cutting directly on the surface and contact with fire

blaty-spieki-kwarcowe.title: Sintered Quartz Worktops
blaty-spieki-kwarcowe.html:
Modern sintered quartz is made of approx. 90-95% natural ground quartzite and quartz bound with resins. It is extremely hard and resistant to scratches, stains, acids and high temperatures. It requires no maintenance.

Technical Specifications

  • Composition: 90-95% natural quartzite and quartz + resins
  • Standard thicknesses: 12mm and 20mm
  • Edge finishing: Can be thickened, as with stone
Surface types:
  • Smooth gloss: Striking, easy to clean, enhances the depth of colour
  • Matt (soft, satin, velvet): Velvety to the touch, hides minor scratches
  • Textured/porous ("Rock", "Terra"): Textures imitating raw stone or concrete while remaining highly stain-resistant
Advantages of sintered quartz:
  • • Non-porous – excellent hygiene, stain resistance
  • • Exceptional durability and hardness – resistant to scratches and impacts
  • • A wealth of patterns and colours – from plain to marble and concrete effects
  • • Maintenance-free – no sealing required

Applications

  • ✅ Kitchens (ideal around the sink and hob)
  • ✅ Bathrooms (vanity tops, window sills, shower enclosures)
  • ✅ Areas requiring the highest hygiene
  • ✅ Commercial interiors (reception desks, bars, tables)
  • ✅ Projects demanding exceptional design

blaty-zywica-epoksydowa.html:

  • Coating: Epoxy resin

  • Customisation: Unlimited colour and effect options
Special effects:
  • Backlit (LED): Integrated lighting possible
  • Ocean Depth effect: Blue and green shades with a wave effect
  • Cosmos imitation: Black resin with glitter particles
  • Geode: Embedded real crystals and minerals

Applications

  • ✅ Kitchen islands and worktops as the centrepiece of the interior
  • ✅ Reception desks, bars, commercial surfaces
  • ✅ Signature furniture and artistic projects
  • ✅ Relaxation areas and teenagers' rooms

blaty-drewniane.title: Wooden Worktops
blaty-drewniane.html:
Made of solid wood (oak, ash, walnut, beech) or laminated glued boards. They create a unique, natural and warm atmosphere. Over time they may develop a patina, which adds to their character. They require periodic maintenance (oiling).

Technical Specifications

  • Material: Solid wood or laminated glued boards
  • Thickness: From 27mm to 40mm (thicker to individual order)
  • Maintenance: Periodic oiling required
  • Character: Natural patina that develops over time
Wood types:
  • Oak: Very hard, durable, popular and versatile
  • Ash: Hard, with a distinct, decorative grain
  • Walnut: Noble, with a deep, dark tone
  • Beech: Light, hard, with an even grain

Applications

  • ✅ Kitchens (creates a unique, homely atmosphere)
  • ✅ Table and island tops
  • ✅ Scandinavian, rustic and vintage interiors
  • ⚠️ Requires regular care; sensitive to moisture and high temperatures

blaty-kamienne.title: Stone Worktops (Granite, Marble)
blaty-kamienne.html:
A luxurious, natural and unique material. Every worktop is one of a kind. Granite is very hard and resistant, while marble is softer and prone to scratches and acids (e.g. lemon juice), and requires sealing.

Technical Specifications

  • Material: Natural granite or marble
  • Standard thicknesses: 20mm and 30mm
  • Edge finishing: Special finishing for a thicker appearance
  • Uniqueness: Every worktop has a unique natural pattern
Stone types:
  • Granite: Maximum durability, damage-resistant, very hard
  • Marble: Unique veining, elegant and sophisticated look, softer
Properties:
  • • Granite: Highly resistant to scratches and acids
  • • Marble: Prone to scratches and acids, requires sealing
  • • Natural, unique pattern on every slab
  • • Long-lasting durability with proper care

Applications

  • ✅ Prestigious kitchens and bathrooms
  • ✅ Worktops, window sills, wall cladding
  • ✅ Classic and modern interiors
  • ⚠️ Marble requires special care and sealing

blaty-solid-surface.title: Solid Surface Worktops (e.g. Corian, Hi-Macs, Staron)
blaty-solid-surface.html:
An innovative composite material made of approx. 2/3 natural minerals and 1/3 acrylic resin. Its greatest advantage is that it is seamless – joints are invisible, creating a uniform, monolithic surface.

Technical Specifications

  • Composition: 2/3 natural minerals + 1/3 acrylic resin
  • Sheet thickness: 12mm (bonded to an MDF base)
  • Final worktop thickness: From 30mm to 50mm or more
  • Thermoforming: Can be formed into any shape
Key features and advantages:
  • Seamless and monolithic: A perfectly smooth surface with an integrated sink is possible
  • 3D forming: Rounded fronts, gentle slopes, non-standard shapes
  • Non-porous: The surface is hygienic and resistant to stains and bacterial growth
  • Damage resistance: Minor scratches can be removed by sanding
  • Certificates: Often certified for food contact

Applications

  • ✅ Hospitality (restaurants, bars, hotel kitchens)
  • ✅ Hospitals and medical facilities (for hygiene reasons)
  • ✅ Luxury kitchens and bathrooms (projects requiring integrated sinks)
  • ✅ Surfaces requiring seamless solutions
